definitions.explanation: The act of washing one's face, typically as part of a morning routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{洗面|せんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I wake up in the morning, I first wash my face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}った→洗う：00827_arau⟧。

notes:
{洗面|せんめん} specifically refers to face-washing. In Japanese homes, the ⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧ (washroom) is typically a separate room from the toilet.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧:
⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧ is the ordinary word for the act of washing the face and the one used on cleanser packaging. {洗面|せんめん} is stiffer and mostly appears in compounds naming the fixtures and the room, or in set descriptions of a morning routine.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧: washroom (room for washing face/hands)
- ⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧: washbasin, sink
- ⟦{洗面器|せんめんき}→洗面器：29668_senmenki⟧: wash basin (portable bowl)
- {洗面|せんめん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: toiletry set

JAPANESE HOME LAYOUT:
- ⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧: washroom (sink area)
- ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧: bathroom (for bathing)
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧/⟦{お手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧: toilet

These three are typically separate in Japanese homes.
